caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet composed of a central structure divided into three main vertical sections. At the top, there are two doors with round knobs, hinged on the outer edges, that open outwards; the left door is narrower than the right. Below these doors are two large horizontal drawers of equal size, each with two round knobs. Beneath these drawers is a single, slightly shorter drawer, also with two round knobs. The bottom section consists of three doors, each with a round knob, and all doors have rectangular recessed panels; the left and right doors are narrower than the central door. The entire cabinet is depicted in shades of light brown and tan, suggesting it is made of wood, with the grain visible throughout. The cabinet is shown against a plain light background, and there are subtle shadows cast to the right and below the object, indicating a light source from the left. The perspective shows both the front and the right side of the cabinet.
title: Shaker Cupboard with Drawers
